import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static final int maxm = 2000015;
    static final int maxn = 105 * 55;
    static int n, m, c, d, k;
    static Edge[] edges = new Edge[maxm];
    static int[] head = new int[maxn];
    static int tol;
    static int[] pre = new int[maxn];
    static int[] dis = new int[maxn];
    static boolean[] vis = new boolean[maxn];
    static int N;

    static class Edge {
        int to, next, cap, flow, cost;
        public Edge() {}
    }

    static int readInt(BufferedReader br) throws IOException {
        int x = 0;
        int f = 1;
        int ch;
        while (true) {
            ch = br.read();
            if (ch == -1) break;
            if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') break;
            if (ch == '-') f = -1;
        }
        if (ch == -1) return -1;
        do {
            x = x * 10 + (ch - '0');
            ch = br.read();
        } while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9');
        return x * f;
    }

    static void init(int n) {
        N = n;
        tol = 0;
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
    }

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap, int cost) {
        edges[tol] = new Edge();
        edges[tol].to = v;
        edges[tol].cap = cap;
        edges[tol].cost = cost;
        edges[tol].flow = 0;
        edges[tol].next = head[u];
        head[u] = tol++;
        edges[tol] = new Edge();
        edges[tol].to = u;
        edges[tol].cap = 0;
        edges[tol].cost = -cost;
        edges[tol].flow = 0;
        edges[tol].next = head[v];
        head[v] = tol++;
    }

    static boolean spfa(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(dis, INF);
        Arrays.fill(vis, false);
        Arrays.fill(pre, -1);
        dis[s] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        vis[s] = true;
        q.offer(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            vis[u] = false;
            for (int i = head[u]; i != -1; i = edges[i].next) {
                int v = edges[i].to;
                if (edges[i].cap > edges[i].flow && dis[v] > dis[u] + edges[i].cost) {
                    dis[v] = dis[u] + edges[i].cost;
                    pre[v] = i;
                    if (!vis[v]) {
                        vis[v] = true;
                        q.offer(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return pre[t] != -1;
    }

    static int minCostFlow(int s, int t, int[] costHolder) {
        int flow = 0;
        int cost = 0;
        while (spfa(s, t)) {
            int Min = INF;
            for (int i = pre[t]; i != -1; i = pre[edges[i ^ 1].to]) {
                if (Min > edges[i].cap - edges[i].flow)
                    Min = edges[i].cap - edges[i].flow;
            }
            for (int i = pre[t]; i != -1; i = pre[edges[i ^ 1].to]) {
                edges[i].flow += Min;
                edges[i ^ 1].flow -= Min;
                cost += edges[i].cost * Min;
            }
            flow += Min;
        }
        costHolder[0] = cost;
        return flow;
    }

    static int point(int x, int y) {
        return (x - 1) * 50 + y;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        int S = 101 * 55;
        int T = S + 1;
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        init(T + 1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            int tmp = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
            addEdge(S, tmp, 1, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= 50; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= 103; j++) {
                int x = point(j, i);
                int y = point(j + 1, i);
                addEdge(x, y, INF, c);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 102; i++) {
            int tmp = i * 50 + 1;
            addEdge(tmp, T, INF, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int u = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int v = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int j = 1; j <= 102; j++) {
                int x = point(j, u);
                int x1 = point(j + 1, u);
                int y1 = point(j + 1, v);
                int y = point(j, v);
                for (int k = 0; k < 50; k++) {
                    int val = d * (k * 2 + 1) + c;
                    addEdge(x, y1, 1, val);
                    addEdge(y, x1, 1, val);
                }
            }
        }
        int[] costHolder = new int[1];
        minCostFlow(S, T, costHolder);
        System.out.println(costHolder[0]);
    }
}
